LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_IV.label: lesser umbral reactor
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_IV.description: Produces power by stealing momentum from ubiquitous non-interacting particles - which amounts to 'free energy' in simple, small words.
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_IV.label: umbral battery
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_IV.description: Stores apocalyptic amounts of electricity for later use. This model has been designed for civilian use, and as such it has no countermeasures to account for rain and fire.
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralShield.label: umbral shield
LanguageData.BOR_UmbralShield.description: Raises a permanent crimson dome 35 tiles in radius. Hostile fire from outside cannot cross it, drop pods cannot land under it, and solar flares do not reach the buildings inside. Tenebrite stops emitting within the dome because the shield takes over: every pawn beneath it slowly falls to tenebral psychosis. Orientis pawns cannot bear being near it.
